description: We are young passionate students from Tajikistan building an educational website to explore space, learn facts, build your own spaceship, and see real-time space stats. Our team: Muzaffar, software engineer with his own browser and U.S. Embassy’s American Space Khujand fellow; Bekzod, SMM specialist and ASK fellow; Damirbek, fluent English speaker, Camp Rising Sun finalist and ASK alumnus; Saboatkhon, FLEX alumna and ASK administration head.
